diagnosis: The Laravel Nova resource indexQuery fails to filter invoice records by the company identifier of the authenticated staff user. Unless an operator is a platform super-admin, back-office users must only view invoices from their assigned company; here, index and global search expose financial records from all corporate clients.
exploit_request:
GET /nova-api/invoices?search=Acme+Corp HTTP/1.1
Host: nova.fincloud-billing.com
Cookie: nova_session=eyJsYXJhdmVsIjoiY29tcGFueV91c2VyIn0=
Accept: application/json
